name: Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse
scope: Standing Sunda Kelapa Lighthouse, with the original white stone shaft, gallery and historic lantern profile on the original location by Jakarta Fish Port.
era: Standing nineteenth-century tower at its present mapped site, using the original 1875 gallery and lantern as the visual basis.

originalReview.notes: The dated 1875 museum album print clearly records the stone shaft, two vertically aligned round windows, projecting gallery moulding, guardrail and glazed lantern.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Checked all published Qualla stills first. The two images have attribution or share-alike terms. The Wereldmuseum’s dated original from the 1875 Woodbury and Page album provides the public-domain tower view.
